parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the switch buttons on the wall switch assembly, made of durable ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a control mechanism to open or close an electrical circuit, turning a connected device on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by a small pivot or press action, toggling between on and off positions.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another switch button on the wall switch assembly, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, allowing independent operation of connected devices.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pressing or toggling, similar to the other switches.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the third switch button on the wall switch assembly, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides control for an additional electrical circuit, functioning independently from the others.
parts.Movement_description: It operates through a press or toggle motion, engaging or disengaging the circuit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate for electrical insulation and structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal wiring, sockets, and switch mechanisms, providing a stable and safe mounting surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall, serving as the main structural component.
